none: PAS KENT-DB165B: Silver penny of Edward the Confessor
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A clipped and worn Early Medieval silver penny of Edward the Confessor (AD 1042-1066) 'Expanding Cross' Type, Heavy Coinage (23.1 grains), dating from AD 1050-1053. Mint Uncertain. Obverse: Draped and diademed bust left. inscription:EDP E[R/D RE(CX)]. Reverse: short cross voided with expanding limbs joined at the base by two circles. Inscription [_AN(O)RM:E_]
